--- .github/workflows/staleproof.yml (new)
# Staleproof: on every pull request, a comment with the docs it makes wrong and annotations on those lines;
# every Monday, an audit of all the docs, kept in one issue. No secrets, no database to set up.
# https://staleproof.dev/#/docs/github-action
name: Staleproof
on:
  pull_request:
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 6 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write

jobs:
  docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: rajkaria/staleproof@v1
        # with:
        #   also-index: acme/demo-py-docs   # docs in another repository
